# Coordination scope ambiguity (REF005)

Modifier attachment across and/or is undecidable.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Rule ID | `ref-scope-ambiguity` |
| Family | referential |
| Applies to | `core` |
| Default severity | `warning` |
| Fix | `manual` |
| Evidence | RE |
| Sniffers | vale, llm |
| Contextual evaluation | LLM |

A chain of and/or where a modifier could bind to one term or all of them. The model checks whether the grouping is actually ambiguous.

Bad:  Delete files that are old and unused or temporary.
Good: Delete files older than 30 days.

Not a finding when parentheses or wording fix the grouping.

## Detector metadata

```yaml
- kind: vale
  pattern: \b(and|or) [a-z]+ (and|or) [a-z]+\b
  confidence: medium
  hook_safe: false
- kind: llm
  confidence: medium
  hook_safe: false
```
